description: Removes a specified local user account from the Windows system, excluding protected accounts such as Administrator, DefaultAccount, Guest, and WDAGUtilityAccount. Produces a JSON log with status and error details if any.

script_parameters.name: TargetUser
script_parameters.description: The local user account to be removed from the system.

script_parameters.name: LogPath
script_parameters.description: Path to the rotating human-readable script log.

script_parameters.name: ARLog
script_parameters.description: Active Response JSON log path. Overwrites existing content.
